notes.title: Closed Beta Launch
notes.content: [p]Thank You,[/p][p][/p][p]To all the wonderful gamers & fans of board games who came out to try our Beta development build of [b]Beat The Markets[/b] this weekend at Canada's largest gaming expo [i]Games Con Canada[/i]. Based on player reception and feedback we have several improvements that will be implemented in the coming months before our Early Access launch this September. For those who won a free beta key as part of our Father's Day special, we will have the current build up soon that was being demonstrated for closed beta access of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Player's should note that the current build is not indicative of a final product and we will mark below several of the problems already addressed and on our radar to complete before we launch:[/p][p][/p][p]- Game is local hotseat multiplayer only[/p][p]- Card logic has yet to be implemented[/p][p]- Issues persist with the current loading of a saved game[/p][p]- The end game/win sequence is not triggered[/p][p]- Stats menu is currently broken[/p][p]- Inside camera while moving tokens is disorienting to players[/p][p]- If the game launches into the main menu with the buttons offset in the top left corner, you need to relaunch the game until the menu is displayed correctly[/p][p][/p][p]Features that are working in this build:[/p][p][/p][p]- Dice mechanics[/p][p]- Buying & selling of investments[/p][p]- Market price changes[/p][p]- Turn based player logic is solid[/p][p]- 2 - 4 players local hotseat mode[/p][p]- Animations & Sound[/p][p]- Board spaces all trigger the correct game event[/p]
